title: KPIs
subtitle: Success metrics that steer the team — goals get derived when a KPI drifts off track
rollup_empty_hint: Scan the codebase to build a context map — then KPIs can be scoped to groups and individual contexts.
rollup_pick_project: Pick a project to see its KPI rollup.
context_no_kpis: No KPIs scoped to this context yet.
scan_failed: Could not start the KPI scan
empty_hint: Run a KPI scan to get grounded proposals from your codebase and context map.
empty_with_proposals_hint: Proposals are waiting in the review queue — accept the ones that matter.
connect_tooltip: This KPI needs the {service} connector to be measurable. Open the credential catalog to set it up.
queue_empty_hint: Run a KPI scan to fill this queue, or check back after the next scheduled scan.
env_sim_caption: Simulated by the LLM engine — advisory only. Pace, status and autopilot always read production.
env_no_sim_series: No simulated series in this environment yet — run a simulation to fill it.
conv_stale_hint: The production reading is {days}d older than the sim — use Measure now to confirm.
conv_no_prod: No production measurement yet — the sim has nothing real to converge to.
predict_hint: Research-only pass: re-aim targets from current benchmarks — no measurement, no local run.
predict_dispatched_toast: Prediction refresh dispatched over {count} KPIs — benchmarks, no measurement
sim_mode_l1_hint: Code-grounded simulation only — no live app is driven.
sim_mode_l1l2_hint: After the static pass, the session also drives the running app where a driver exists.
sim_import_hint: Ingest the newest finished simulation run from the repo
sim_dispatched_toast: Simulation dispatched over {count} KPIs — the terminal icon tracks it
sim_skipped_toast: {count} result rows were refused by validation — see the run report
archive_confirm_body: Archived KPIs stop being measured and are fed back to future scans as rejected examples. The measurement history is kept.
explainer: KPIs define what success means for this project. The scan proposes them from your code, measurements track them over time, and when one drifts off track the system derives a goal for your team to fix it — the next measurement shows whether it worked.
derived_qa_bounce: how often QA sends work back for fixes
derived_exec_failure: how often the team's runs fail
derived_parked_age: how long work waits for your sign-off
describe_derived: Tracked {cadence} from the team's own workflow — {what}.
describe_derived_generic: Tracked {cadence} from the team's own workflow.
describe_manual: You enter this value yourself whenever you have it.
pace_on_dated: On pace — {pct}% of the way to {target} {unit}, {days} days left.
pace_off: Falling behind — at {current} {unit} against a target of {target} {unit}.
pace_off_dated: Falling behind — {current} {unit} now, {target} {unit} needed in {days} days.
evidence_tooltip: This baseline was measured from your repository during the scan — not estimated.
linked_goals_hint: {count} goal(s) derived from this KPI — markers on the chart show where they landed.
chart_no_data: The story chart appears after the first measurement.
chart_legend: Dashed line = target ({target} {unit}). Vertical marks = derived goals.
goal_link_subtitle: This goal was derived to move this metric — the next measurement, not the goal finishing, decides if it worked.
goal_ungrounded_body: Progress here reflects checklist completion — it can read done even if the work never moved the real number. Set up a KPI to ground this goal in a measured outcome.
steering_none_offtrack: Off track — no goal in flight yet.
steering_outcome_pending: Shipped — awaiting the next measurement to see if it moved.
autopilot_off_desc: Nothing runs automatically for this project.
autopilot_measure_desc: Measures this project's KPIs on schedule.
autopilot_suggest_desc: Measures KPIs and derives a goal when one goes off-track — you hand it to the team.
autopilot_full_desc: Measures, derives goals, and ships them through your team automatically.
wizard_type_hint: Pick the metric type. Sources are matched to the type, never to a single tool.
wizard_no_matches: Nothing in your vault can answer this metric type yet.
wizard_testing_note: Then it runs once against the live API to prove the number comes back.
wizard_request_section: The exact request it will replay
wizard_freeze_note_recipe: A pre-built, tested procedure. Every future measurement replays it exactly — no AI at runtime.
wizard_freeze_note_llm: Composed once for this wiring. After you confirm, it is frozen and replayed exactly — no AI at runtime.
source_none_hint: Recorded by hand. Connect a live source to measure automatically.
source_degraded_banner: The last replay against {service} failed. Automatic measurement is paused until you reconnect.
evaluate_none_due: No KPIs were due for measurement.
populate_lane_simulation_detail: For a product that has not shipped: walks your features as representative users to estimate the adopted KPIs, and researches targets from comparable products. The longest step.
populate_scope_empty: Pick at least one thing to cover.
pace_unpaced: Measured, but with no target date there is nothing to fall behind. Add one so the system can steer this.
pace_unpaced_no_target: Measured, but no target is set, so there is nothing to steer toward yet.
